title: Snickers x Shingeki no Kyojin
content:
Talk about a sugar rush. I have never viewed Snickers this unappealing until they paired it up with Attach on Titan.
Who asked for this? I feel like this question is asked way too much around these obscure Anime collab content craze, but really, did we need this?

Short answer; yes we do. Listen, I have my issues with Attack on Titan, and I also have other issues with the branch Snickers itself as well, however, I'm not gonna lie, this abomination of a fever dream is ... entertaining?! For some, absolutely, for me? I don't think so. The humor didn't click in, the collaboration made nosense, the kind of obscure that hurts the soul, the kind you'd want to collect if it was physical though.
